title.zh: Bitcoin Core调整安全漏洞披露政策以应对AI发现漏洞
title.en: Bitcoin Core正调整其安全政策，部分漏洞将立即修复并公开

current_state.zh: Bitcoin Core is revising its security vulnerability policy because large language models make some flaws easier to rediscover, reducing the value of lengthy embargoes and delaying fixed releases.
current_state.en: Bitcoin Core is revising its security vulnerability policy because large language models make some flaws easier to rediscover, reducing the value of lengthy embargoes and delaying fixed releases.

updates.title_zh: Bitcoin Core正调整其安全政策，部分漏洞将立即修复并公开
updates.title_en: Bitcoin Core正调整其安全政策，部分漏洞将立即修复并公开
updates.what_changed_zh: Bitcoin Core is revising its security vulnerability disclosure policy so that flaws easily discoverable via LLM prompts are fixed across maintained releases and publicly disclosed as soon as possible, while other vulnerabilities retain severity-based staged disclosure.
